column1: # Display strings for both analyze scripts. UTF-8, tab separated.
# The scripts themselves stay pure ASCII on purpose: Windows PowerShell 5.1
# reads .ps1 files as the system codepage unless they carry a BOM, so non-ASCII
# text inside the script breaks parsing on many machines. Keeping translations
# here sidesteps that entirely, and lets both scripts share one source.
# Only these three languages ship. For any other language the agent translates
# the report itself, which costs nothing extra and covers everyone.
